meta.name: google-workspace
meta.description: Interact with Google Workspace — Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Sheets, Docs, Tasks, Chat, and cross-service workflows. Read emails, manage files, check schedule, send messages, and automate productivity tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 收发邮件、管理日程并同步云端文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每天都要在Google办公套件里处理大量事务
copy.tagline_en: Automate email, calendar, and file workflows in Google Workspace
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you spend a lot of time on Google's productivity apps daily.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过 gws 命令读取 Gmail 邮件、查看日历日程、搜索下载 Drive 文件、读写表格文档、管理任务、发送 Chat 消息,并执行跨服务流程(如站会报告)。
howto.when: 当用户提出处理邮件、查看日程、管理文件等涉及 Google 工作区的请求时触发;需先确认 gws CLI 已完成 OAuth 认证。

say.text: 帮我看下今天有哪些日程和待办
say.note: Claude 会调用站会报告流程,汇总日程与任务。

say.text: 列出收件箱里未读的发票邮件
say.note: Claude 会用 Gmail 筛选,返回发件人和主题。

say.text: 在云端硬盘里搜索标题含'预算'的文件
say.note: Claude 列出匹配的 Drive 文件及 ID。

howto.what_en: Claude can use the gws CLI to read Gmail, check Calendar, manage Drive files, edit Sheets/Docs, handle Tasks, send Chat messages, and run cross-service workflows like a daily standup report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to handle email, check schedules, manage files, or similar Google Workspace tasks; requires gws CLI to be authenticated with OAuth.

say_en.text: What meetings and tasks do I have today?
say_en.note: Claude runs the standup report workflow.

say_en.text: List unread invoice emails from my inbox.
say_en.note: Claude filters Gmail and shows sender/subject.
